# BL-0009 clarification context

Human authority, current chat, verbatim: "Let's clarify BL-0009". Scope is business clarification and a proposed request for review, not product implementation, framework maintenance, installation, saved-setting changes, backlog rewriting or closure. Direct execution of the installed Business-analyst instructions; no separate agent was spawned. The registered installed definition validates; selected empty owned configuration is defaulted at `.hai_env/config/agents/business-analyst.json`, effective settings {}, configured fields [], issues []. The standard/high profile resolves to host-advertised gpt-6.1-terra/high; no availability is inferred from the profile alone.

Current Activity UUID: 28c261fc-859f-4dab-bc34-3a840d007bf4. Initial input was empty; no prior clarification ledger exists. The first actual question batch creates decisions.md before any refined proposal. Original draft: backlog/new/BL-0009.md, "Every agent should be able to have a setup parameters when deployed in a specific workspace". Why and acceptance criteria are explicitly unspecified. No relevant settled clarification decision is present.

Read context: the complete selected backlog item; applicable installed Business-analyst rules, procedures and owned conventions/helper documentation; shared Activity, agent and configuration conventions; README and configuration helper documentation; bounded representative Git-manager and Specification-manager configuration contracts. Core already requires a package-local configuration/contract.json for every agent, allows empty contracts, and stores per-workspace overrides at .hai_env/config/agents/<agent-name>.json. Supported types are booleans and workspace-relative directories. Missing files/values use defaults, invalid values are reported without silent fallback, and external settings survive package replacement. Existing examples are Git capability flags and specification enablement/location. Core runtime configuration read/update operations already exist.

The available local files are sufficient to establish current capability and the overlap with the old draft. No primary product-context References registry was supplied; no registry-discovered resources or prompts were loaded. Specifications are disabled in validated settings and are not enabled for this task. The missing information is human intent: confirm existing coverage versus a new capability, and a motivating observable scenario. Safe implementation choices are not asked as blockers. No technical architecture/planning or implementation begins while readiness is unresolved; no exemption is claimed. A complete 28-item assessment and copy-ready proposal follow only after actual decisions are durably saved.

Core chronicles remain enabled. No explicit saved source path/range is available; no source discovery, reconstruction or coverage claim is made. The earlier one-time recording exception applied only to the completed prior Activity/commit, not this new Activity. Usage attribution remains unavailable. Current prompt cadence has not reached five Activity clarification prompts.

Operational note: initial working-folder creation omitted the missing files/ parent and failed before any file write; the three dependent read-only requests consequently failed as missing. Inspection confirmed no partial files. The corrected Activity working area was created and all three prerequisite checks actually passed. No unavailable check is counted as passed.
